page.overview:
What is Briar Wolf?

Briar Wolves were dangerous quadrupedal animals native to the planet Ryushi.

Briar Wolves were scaly reptilian carnivores with vaguely canine traits. They were quadrupedal, with sharp claws. Their skin was reddish and they featured a a mouth full of sharp teeth. They also bled red blood.

Briar Wolves were known to kill rhynth, and were in turn hunted by .
